notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (product team building an internal AI product assistant for end users and support agents).
- Evaluating Hosted API first to validate latency/behavior; if ok, move to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput and lower tail latency.

Requirements / priorities:
- Primary workload: real-time chat/agent orchestration with tool-calling (DB lookups, CRM writes) and streaming responses to UI.
- Latency SLO: target 200ms median per streamed token and p95 under 400ms for interactive agent steps (CTO quote: 'need consistent 200ms median stream token latency for agent actions').
- Throughput: expected 400-800 concurrent active users during peak; cost-sensitive - wants predictable pricing for Dedicated.
- Quality gating: require prompt/eval regression checks before model rollouts. Looking for A/B + canary rollout support and automated regression alerts tied to prompt test suites.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs for agent actions, customer-managed KMS, data residency (NA).

POC notes + technical findings:
- Hosted API demo showed streaming + function/tool-calling working end-to-end; tool call latency currently adds ~40-60ms depending on downstream.
- Mid-POC perf snapshot: median stream token latency ~180-220ms under our synthetic load; p95 spikes to ~420ms during bursty requests - concern for SLA.
- NVMe caching and prefix KV hits reduced repeated prompt costs in tests; team wants guidance from Redwood Optimize on batching and quantization tradeoffs.
- SE recommended canary rollout pattern: small % traffic to new model variant + eval suite run on prod traffic via sampled prompts. Conversight wants policy to auto-roll-back on eval regressions.

Commercial / procurement:
- Price sensitivity noted around cost per concurrent user and per-token for high-throughput bursts. Interested in dedicated committed discounts if performance meets SLOs.
- Finance asked for 12-month committed quote (Estimated ARR range: $50k-$150k).

Quotes / verbatim:
- CTO: 'If we can't get predictable interactive latency, we can't ship agent flows to customers.'
- Head of Product: 'Eval gating is non-negotiable - we need to avoid regressions from model updates.'

Next steps (short):
- Redwood SE to deliver tuned POC config: streaming buffer, KV cache, batching policy (by 2026-03-05).
- Complete SOC2 evidence handoff and KMS integration docs by 2026-03-10.
- Pricing review with finance and draft Dedicated commitment by 2026-03-20.
